Enabled Cache Components and Partial Prefetching in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts). Project totals now use `use cache` in [projects.ts](/workspace/lib/projects.ts), while [page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx) keeps the workspace heading and totals visible as member details load through a Suspense boundary. Name and team still come from cookies; region still comes from the request header.
